noDataHint: No usage observed yet. It appears when a source reports values
lastSuccess: Last success {rel}. Will try again next cycle
oldValue: The reset time has passed — the value shown may be from the previous window
unlinkedHint: Subscription usage appears once you connect the Claude Code status line
openLabel: Select to open the usage screen
clickToOpen: Click to open the usage screen
statusOnlyDetail: No usage rate — this source reports status only

menu.label: Usage indicator menu
menu.refreshTooSoon: Just refreshed. Try again in a moment
menu.hidden: The usage indicator is hidden. You can turn it back on in settings
menu.hideFailed: Couldn't hide the indicator. Turn it off in settings

settings.pollNotice: When on, the server collects usage every 30 seconds (only while the tab is visible, even if the usage screen is closed). This isn't new polling; it keeps the usage screen's refresh always on.
settings.enabledOffNote: When off, the other items don't apply.
settings.placementHelp: A floating chip can cover content. If it gets in the way, change the corner or use a sidebar position.
settings.placementUnknown: Unknown position ({id}) — shown at the bottom of the sidebar.
settings.windowsEmpty: When empty, as many windows as fit are shown, starting from the first in the order the sources gave.
settings.ruleNote: Rules use the usage rate. Even in "Amount left" mode, the usage rate is the basis.
settings.ruleDuplicate: A rule with the same usage rate exists
settings.ruleToneUnknown: Unknown color ({id}) — drawn in the default color.
